purpose: SHA-256 digests of the Dapr CLI and runtime archives that CI downloads for the HexalithDaprCliVersion and HexalithDaprRuntimeVersion pins in Directory.Packages.props. A pin without an entry here is refused before extraction.
source: Each value equals the upstream <archive>.sha256 checksum file and the GitHub release asset digest published with that dapr/cli or dapr/dapr release, and was recomputed from the downloaded archive on 2026-11-09.
